40020666.author: पदार्थः
40020666.content: एवम् thus, सञ्चिन्त्य having thought, विप्रेन्दो the best of Brahmins (Narada), जगाम went, लघुविक्रमः with swift steps, आख्यातुम् to tell, तत् that, यथावृत्तम् as it happened, यमस्य of Yama, सदनम् abode, प्रति towards,

40020666.author: Translation
40020666.content: Having thus pondered, Narada, moving swiftly, went towards Yama's abode to narrate the events as they had transpired.

40020667.author: पदार्थः
40020667.content: अपश्यत् he saw, स he, यमम् Yama, तत्र there, देवम् the god, अग्निपुरस्कृतम् with fire placed in front, विधानम् the ordinance, उपतिष्ठन्तम् administering, प्राणिनो of beings, यस्य whose, यादृशम् as it is,

40020667.author: Translation
40020667.content: There, Narada saw the god Yama, honored by fire, administering the fate of all beings as it was ordained for each.

40020668.author: पदार्थः
40020668.content: स he, तु indeed, दृष्ट्वा having seen, यमः Yama, प्राप्तम् arrived, महर्षिम् the great sage, तत्र there, नारदम् Narada, अब्रवीत् he spoke, सुखमासीनम् comfortably seated, अर्घ्यम् water offering, आवेद्य having offered, धर्मतः according to dharma,

40020668.author: Translation
40020668.content: Upon seeing the great sage Narada arrive there, Yama, having properly offered him a water offering and seated him comfortably, then spoke.

40020669.author: पदार्थः
40020669.content: कच्चित् is it that, क्षेमम् well-being, तु indeed, देवर्षे O divine sage, कच्चित् is it that, धर्मो dharma, न not, नश्यति perishes, किम् what, आगमनकृत्यम् purpose of arrival, ते your, देवगन्धर्वसेवित O one served by gods and gandharvas,

40020669.author: Translation
40020669.content: Yama asked, "O divine sage, is all well with you, and is dharma not perishing? What is the purpose of your visit, O one revered by gods and gandharvas?"

40020670.author: पदार्थः
40020670.content: अब्रवीत् spoke, तु indeed, तदा then, वाक्यं words, नारदः Narada, भगवान् revered, ऋषिः sage, श्रूयताम् listen, अभिधास्यामि I will tell, विधानं the plan, च and, विधीयताम् let it be done.

40020670.author: Translation
40020670.content: Then, the revered sage Narada spoke these words: "Listen, I will tell you the plan, and let it be carried out."

40020671.author: पदार्थः
40020671.content: एषः this one, नाम्नः by name, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, पितृराज O King of Pitrus, निशाचरः the demon, उपयाति approaches, वशं under control, नेतुं to bring, विक्रमैः by his valor, त्वां you, सुदुर्जयम् who are very difficult to conquer.

40020671.author: Translation
40020671.content: O King of Pitrus, this demon named Dashagriva is approaching to bring you, who are very difficult to conquer, under his control through his valor.

40020672.author: पदार्थः
40020672.content: एतेन by this, कारणेन reason, अहं I, त्वरितः quickly, हि indeed, आगतः have come, प्रभो O Lord, दण्डप्रहरणस्य of the wielder of the staff, अद्य today, तव your, किं what, नु indeed, भविष्यति will happen.

40020672.author: Translation
40020672.content: O Lord, it is for this reason that I have quickly come; what will happen today to you, the wielder of the staff of punishment?

40020673.author: पदार्थः
40020673.content: एतस्मिन् in this, अन्तरे interval, दुरात् from afar, अंशुमन्तम् the sun, इव like, उदितम् risen, ददृशुः they saw, दीप्तम् shining, आयान्तं coming, विमानं the aerial chariot, तस्य his, रक्षसः of the demon.

40020673.author: Translation
40020673.content: In the meantime, from afar, they saw the demon's radiant aerial chariot approaching, shining like the rising sun.

40020674.author: पदार्थः
40020674.content: तं that, देशं region, प्रभया by the radiance, तस्य of that, पुष्पकस्य Pushpaka, महाबलः the mighty one, कृत्वा having made, वितिमिरं free from darkness, सर्वं all, समीपं near, सः he, अभ्यवर्तत approached.

40020674.author: Translation
40020674.content: The mighty one, Ravana, having illuminated the entire region with the radiance of his Pushpaka chariot, then approached that place.

40020675.author: पदार्थः
40020675.content: सः he, महाबाहुः the mighty-armed, दशग्रीवः Dashagriva, अपश्यत् saw, ततस्ततः here and there, प्राणिनः living beings, सुकृतं कर्म good deeds, भुञ्जानान् experiencing, च and, एव indeed, दुष्कृतम् evil deeds.

40020675.author: Translation
40020675.content: The mighty-armed Dashagriva saw living beings everywhere experiencing the fruits of both their good and evil deeds.

40020676.author: पदार्थः
40020676.content: अपश्यत् he saw, सैनिकान् soldiers, च and, अस्य his, यमस्य of Yama, अनुचरैः attendants, सह with, यमस्य of Yama, पुरुषैः by men, उग्रैः fierce, घोररूपैः of dreadful form, भयानकैः terrifying.

40020676.author: Translation
40020676.content: He also saw Yama's soldiers along with his fierce, dreadful, and terrifying attendants.

40020677.author: पदार्थः
40020677.content: ददर्श he saw, वध्यमानान् being killed, च and, क्लिश्यमानान् being tormented, च and, देहिनः embodied beings, क्रोशतः crying out, च and, महानादं a great cry, तीव्रनिष्टनतत्परान् intent on intense wailing.

40020677.author: Translation
40020677.content: He saw embodied beings being killed and tormented, crying out with a great cry and intent on intense wailing.

40020678.author: पदार्थः
40020678.content: कृमिभिः by worms, भक्ष्यमाणान् being devoured, च and, सारमेयैः by dogs, च and, दारुणैः fierce.

40020678.author: Translation
40020678.content: He saw them being devoured by worms and by fierce dogs.

40020679.author: पदार्थः
40020679.content: क्षोत्रायासकराः causing distress to the ears, वाचः words, वदतः speaking, च and, भयावहाः terrifying, सन्तार्यमाणान् being made to cross, वैतरणीं the Vaitarani, बहुशः repeatedly, शोणितोदकाम् having blood as water.

40020679.author: Translation
40020679.content: He heard them uttering terrifying cries that caused distress to the ears, and saw them repeatedly being made to cross the Vaitarani river, whose waters were blood.

40020680.author: पदार्थः
40020680.content: वालुकासु in sands, च and, तप्तासु hot, तप्यमानान् being tormented, मुहूर्मुहुः again and again, असिपत्रवने in the forest of sword-leaves, च and, एव indeed, भिद्यमानान् being cut/pierced, अधार्मिकान् the unrighteous ones

40020680.author: Translation
40020680.content: Ravana saw the unrighteous being tormented repeatedly in hot sands and cut in the forest of sword-leaves.

40020681.author: पदार्थः
40020681.content: रौरवे in Raurava (hell), क्षारनद्यां in the river of caustic liquid, च and, क्षुरधारासु on razor-sharp edges, च and, एव indeed, हि surely, पानीयं water, याचमानांश्च and begging, तृषितान् thirsty, क्षुधितानपि and hungry

40020681.author: Translation
40020681.content: He also saw them in Raurava hell, in the caustic river, and on razor-sharp edges, begging for water while thirsty and hungry.

40020682.author: पदार्थः
40020682.content: शवभूतान् like corpses, कृशान् emaciated, दीनान् miserable, विवर्णान् discolored, मुक्तमूर्धजान् with disheveled hair, मलपङ्कधरान् covered in dirt and mud, दीनान् miserable, रूक्षान् rough (in appearance), च and, परिधावतः running around

40020682.author: Translation
40020682.content: These miserable beings appeared like corpses, emaciated, discolored, with disheveled hair, covered in dirt and mud, and were running around frantically.

40020683.author: पदार्थः
40020683.content: ददर्श saw, रावणो Ravana, मार्गे on the path, शतशो by hundreds, अथ then, सहस्रशः by thousands, कांश्चित् some, च and, गृहमुख्येषु in excellent houses, गीतवादित्रनिःस्वनैः with sounds of singing and musical instruments, प्रमोदमानान् rejoicing, अद्राक्षीत् saw, रावणः Ravana, सुकृतैः by their good deeds, स्वकैः own

40020683.author: Translation
40020683.content: Ravana saw hundreds and thousands of such beings on his path, but he also saw others rejoicing in splendid houses with sounds of music and singing, enjoying the fruits of their own good deeds.

40020684.author: पदार्थः
40020684.content: गौरसं milk products (or cows), गोप्रदातारो givers of cows, हि indeed, अन्नं food, च and, एव indeed, अन्नदायिनः givers of food, गृहान् houses, च and, गृहदातारः givers of houses, स्वकर्मफलम् the fruit of their own actions, अश्नतः enjoying

40020684.author: Translation
40020684.content: Those who gave cows enjoyed milk products, givers of food enjoyed food, and givers of houses enjoyed houses, thus partaking in the fruits of their own good deeds.

40020685.author: पदार्थः
40020685.content: सुवर्णमणिमुक्ताभिः with gold, gems, and pearls, प्रमदाभिः by beautiful women, अलङ्कृतान् adorned.

40020685.author: Translation
40020685.content: This describes beings who were adorned by beautiful women with gold, gems, and pearls.

40020686.author: पदार्थः
40020686.content: धार्मिकान् righteous ones, अपरान् others, तत्र there, दीप्यमानान् shining, स्वतेजसा by their own splendor, ददर्श saw, सुमहाबाहू the very mighty-armed, रावणो Ravana, राक्षसाधिपः the lord of Rakshasas.

40020686.author: Translation
40020686.content: The very mighty-armed Ravana, the lord of Rakshasas, saw other righteous beings there, shining with their own splendor.

40020687.author: पदार्थः
40020687.content: ततः then, तान् them, भिद्यमानांश्च and being tormented, कर्मभिः by deeds, दुष्कृतैः evil, स्वकैः their own, रावणो Ravana, मोचयामास released, विक्रमेण by valor, बलात् by force, बली the powerful one.

40020687.author: Translation
40020687.content: Then, the powerful Ravana, by his valor and force, released those who were being tormented by their own evil deeds.

40020688.author: पदार्थः
40020688.content: प्राणिनो the beings, मोचिताः released, तेन by him, दशग्रीवेण by Dashagriva, रक्षसा by the Rakshasa, सुखम् happiness, आपूः attained, मुहूर्तं for a moment, ते they, हि indeed, अतर्कितम् unexpected, अचिन्तितम् unthought of.

40020688.author: Translation
40020688.content: The beings released by that Rakshasa Dashagriva indeed attained unexpected and unthought-of happiness for a moment.

40020689.author: पदार्थः
40020689.content: प्रेतेषु when the dead, मुच्यमानेषु were being released, राक्षसेन by the Rakshasa, महीयसा the mighty, प्रेतगोपाः the guardians of the dead, सुसङ्क्रुद्धाः very enraged, राक्षसेन्द्रम् towards the lord of Rakshasas, अभिद्रवन् rushed.

40020689.author: Translation
40020689.content: When the dead were being released by the mighty Rakshasa, the guardians of the dead became very enraged and rushed towards the lord of Rakshasas.

40020690.author: पदार्थः
40020690.content: ततः then, हलहलाशब्दः a tumultuous sound, सर्वदिग्भ्यः from all directions, समुत्थितः arose, धर्मराजस्य of Yama, योधानाम् of the warriors, शूराणाम् of the brave ones, सम्प्रधावताम् who were rushing forward.

40020690.author: Translation
40020690.content: Then, a great tumultuous roar arose from all directions, made by the brave warriors of Yama who were charging forward.

40020691.author: पदार्थः
40020691.content: ते they, प्रासैः with spears, परिघैः with iron clubs, शूलैः with lances, मुसलैः with maces, शक्तितोमरैः with javelins and lances, पुष्पकम् upon the Pushpaka, समवर्षन्त showered, शूराः the brave ones, शतसहस्रशः by hundreds of thousands.

40020691.author: Translation
40020691.content: Hundreds of thousands of those brave warriors showered the Pushpaka chariot with spears, iron clubs, lances, maces, javelins, and other missiles.

40020692.author: पदार्थः
40020692.content: ते they, पुष्पकस्य of the Pushpaka, आसनानि its seats, प्रासादान् its palaces, वेदिकाः its platforms, तोरणानि its archways, च and, बभञ्जुः broke, शीघ्रम् quickly, मधुकराः bees, इव like.

40020692.author: Translation
40020692.content: They quickly shattered the seats, palaces, platforms, and archways of the Pushpaka chariot, just like bees.

40020693.author: पदार्थः
40020693.content: तत् that, देवनिष्ठानभूतम् which was a dwelling place of gods, विमानम् aerial chariot, पुष्पकम् Pushpaka, मृधे in battle, भज्यमानम् being broken, तथैव even so, ब्रह्मतेजसा by the power of Brahma, अक्षयम् indestructible, आसीत् remained.

40020693.author: Translation
40020693.content: Even though that divine Pushpaka aerial chariot, which was a dwelling place for gods, was being shattered in battle, it remained indestructible due to the power of Brahma.

40020694.author: पदार्थः
40020694.content: तस्य his, महात्मनः of the great-souled one (Yama), सेना army, असङ्ख्या countless, सुमहती very great, आसीत् was, शूराणाम् of brave ones, अग्रयातानाम् who were leading, शतानि hundreds, च and, सहस्राणि thousands.

40020694.author: Translation
40020694.content: The army of that great-souled Yama was immeasurably vast, comprising hundreds and thousands of brave warriors leading the charge.

40020695.author: पदार्थः
40020695.content: ततः then, वृक्षैः च with trees and, शैलैः च with mountains and, प्रासादानाम् शतैः तथा with hundreds of palaces also, ततः then, ते those, सचिवाः तस्य his ministers, यथाकामम् as desired, यथाबलम् according to their strength, अयुध्यन्त fought, महावीराः great heroes, सः च and he, राजा king, दशाननः Dashanana.

40020695.author: Translation
40020695.content: Then, those great heroic ministers of Ravana, along with King Dashanana himself, fought using trees, mountains, and hundreds of palaces, as they wished and according to their strength.

40020696.author: पदार्थः
40020696.content: ते तु but they, शोणितदिग्धाङ्गाः whose limbs were smeared with blood, सर्वशस्त्रसमाहताः struck by all weapons, अमात्याः ministers, राक्षसेन्द्रस्य of the king of Rakshasas, चक्रुः waged, आयोधनम् battle, महत् great.

40020696.author: Translation
40020696.content: Though their limbs were smeared with blood and they were struck by all sorts of weapons, those ministers of the Rakshasa king waged a great battle.

40020697.author: पदार्थः
40020697.content: अन्योन्यम् each other, ते those, महाभागाः great ones, जघ्नुः struck, प्रहरणैः with weapons, भृशम् fiercely, यमस्य च and of Yama, महाबाहो O mighty-armed one, रावणस्य च and of Ravana, मन्त्रिणः ministers.

40020697.author: Translation
40020697.content: O mighty-armed one, those great ministers of Yama and Ravana fiercely struck each other with their weapons.

40020698.author: पदार्थः
40020698.content: अमात्यान् तान् तु but those ministers, सन्त्यज्य abandoning, यमयोधाः Yama's warriors, महाबलाः mighty, तम् एव च and him alone, अभ्यधावन्त rushed towards, शूलवर्षैः with showers of spears, दशाननम् Dashanana.

40020698.author: Translation
40020698.content: The mighty warriors of Yama, abandoning those ministers, rushed directly towards Dashanana (Ravana) with showers of spears.

40020699.author: पदार्थः
40020699.content: ततः then, शोणितदिग्धाङ्गः whose limbs were smeared with blood, प्रहारैः by blows, जर्जरीकृतः wounded, फुल्ल अशोकः a blooming Ashoka tree, इव like, आभाति appeared, पुष्पके on the Pushpaka, राक्षसाधिपः the lord of Rakshasas.

40020699.author: Translation
40020699.content: Then, the lord of Rakshasas, Ravana, with his limbs smeared with blood and wounded by the blows, appeared on his Pushpaka chariot like a blooming Ashoka tree.

40020700.author: पदार्थः
40020700.content: सः he, तु indeed, शूलगदापासाञ्छक्तितोमरसायकान् spears, maces, nooses, shaktis, javelins, and arrows, मुसलानि pestles, शिलावृक्षान् stones and trees, मुमोच hurled, अस्त्रबलात् by the power of his weapons, बली the powerful one.

40020700.author: Translation
40020700.content: The powerful one indeed hurled spears, maces, nooses, shaktis, javelins, arrows, pestles, stones, and trees, empowered by his missile knowledge.

40020701.author: पदार्थः
40020701.content: तरूणां of trees, च and, शिलानां of stones, च and, शस्त्राणां of weapons, च and, अतिदारुणम् very terrible, तत् that, वर्षं shower, यमसैन्येषु upon Yama's armies, पपात fell, धरणीतले on the surface of the earth.

40020701.author: Translation
40020701.content: That extremely terrible shower of trees, stones, and weapons fell upon Yama's armies on the surface of the earth.

40020702.author: पदार्थः
40020702.content: तान् them, तु but, सर्वान् all, विनिर्भिद्य having pierced through, तत् that, अस्त्रम् weapon, अपहत्य having repelled, च and, जघ्नुः they struck, ते they, राक्षसं the demon, घोरम् terrible, एकं one, शतसहस्रशः by hundreds of thousands.

40020702.author: Translation
40020702.content: But having pierced through all those weapons and repelled that missile, Yama's soldiers, in hundreds of thousands, struck that single terrible demon.

40020703.author: पदार्थः
40020703.content: परिवार्य having surrounded, च and, तं him, सर्वे all, शैलं a mountain, मोघोत्करा dense clouds, इव like, भिन्दिपालैः with bhindipalas, च and, शूलैः with spears, च and, निरुच्छ्वासम् breathless, अपोथयन् they crushed.

40020703.author: Translation
40020703.content: And all of them, having surrounded him like dense clouds surrounding a mountain, crushed him with bhindipalas and spears until he was breathless.

40020704.author: पदार्थः
40020704.content: विमुक्तकवचः with his armor loosened, क्रुद्धः enraged, सिक्तः drenched, शोणितविस्रवैः with streams of blood, ततः then, सः he, पुष्पकं the Pushpaka, त्यक्त्वा having abandoned, पृथिव्याम् on the earth, अवतिष्ठत stood.

40020704.author: Translation
40020704.content: With his armor loosened, enraged, and drenched in streams of blood, he then abandoned the Pushpaka chariot and stood on the earth.

40020705.author: पदार्थः
40020705.content: ततः then, स he, कार्मुकी one with a bow, वाणी (the warrior) Indrajit, समरे in battle, च and, अभिवर्तत advanced, लब्धसञ्ज्ञः having regained consciousness, मुहूर्तेन in a moment, क्रुद्धः enraged, तस्थौ stood, यथान्तकः like Yama.

40020705.author: Translation
40020705.content: Then, the bow-wielding Indrajit, having regained consciousness in a moment, stood enraged in battle like the god of death.

40020706.author: पदार्थः
40020706.content: ततः then, पाशुपतम् the Pāśupata, दिव्यम् divine, अस्त्रम् weapon, सन्धाय having fixed, कार्मुके on the bow, तिष्ठ तिष्ठ Stop! Stop!, इति thus, तान् them, उक्त्वा having said, तत् that, चापम् bow, विचकर्ष drew, स he.

40020706.author: Translation
40020706.content: Then, he fixed the divine Pāśupata weapon on his bow, and having told them "Stop! Stop!", he drew that bow.

40020707.author: पदार्थः
40020707.content: आकर्णात् up to his ear, स he, विकृष्य having drawn, अथ then, चापम् the bow, इन्द्रारिः the enemy of Indra (Indrajit), आहवे in battle, मुमोच released, तम् that, शरम् arrow, क्रुद्धः enraged, त्रिपुरे at Tripura, शङ्करः Shiva, यथा just as.

40020707.author: Translation
40020707.content: Then, Indrajit, the enemy of Indra, enraged in battle, drew his bow up to his ear and released that arrow, just as Shiva did at Tripura.

40020708.author: पदार्थः
40020708.content: तस्य its, रूपम् form, शरस्य of the arrow, आसीत् was, विधूमज्वालमण्डलम् a smokeless circle of flames, वनम् a forest, दहिष्यतः about to burn, घर्मे in summer, दावाग्नेः of a forest fire, इव like, मूर्च्छतः raging.

40020708.author: Translation
40020708.content: The form of that arrow was a smokeless circle of flames, like a raging forest fire intensifying in summer, about to consume a forest.

40020709.author: पदार्थः
40020709.content: ज्वालामाली having a garland of flames, स that, तु indeed, शरः arrow, क्रव्यादानुगतः followed by flesh-eaters, रणे in battle, मुक्तः released, गुल्मान् bushes, द्रुमान् trees, च and, अपि even, भस्म ashes, कृत्वा having made, प्रधावति rushes forward.

40020709.author: Translation
40020709.content: That arrow, wreathed in flames and followed by flesh-eating demons, once released in battle, rushed forward, turning bushes and even trees into ashes.

40020710.author: पदार्थः
40020710.content: ते they, तस्य his (enemy's), तेजसा by the power, दग्धाः burnt, सैन्याः armies, वैवस्वतस्य of Vaivasvata (Yama), तु indeed, रणे in the battle, तस्मिन् in that, निपतिताः fallen down, दावदग्धाः burnt by forest fire, नगाः trees, इव like.

40020710.author: Translation
40020710.content: Yama's armies, burnt by the enemy's power in that battle, fell down like trees consumed by a forest fire.

40020711.author: पदार्थः
40020711.content: ततः then, तु indeed, सिचवैः with attendants, सार्धम् together, राक्षसः the demon (Ravana), भीमविक्रमः of terrible prowess, ननाद roared, सुमहानादम् a very great roar, कम्पयन् shaking, इव as if, मेदिनीम् the earth.

40020711.author: Translation
40020711.content: Then, the demon of terrible prowess, Ravana, along with his attendants, let out a very great roar, as if shaking the earth. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीये आदिकाव्ये श्रीमदुत्तरकाण्डे एकविंशः सर्गः ।। 21 ।। Thus ends the twenty-first sarga of Uttara Kanda of the holy Ramayana the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
